name: icloud
mount_caveat: Mounts, but see hazards — this provider has caused the most trouble in practice.
offline_requirement: Turn OFF "Optimise Mac Storage" for this folder, or files get evicted and read as 0 bytes.
delete_note: No iCloud connector exists. Use `allow_cowork_file_delete`; there is no fallback.
hazards: Cloud-only files copy as 0 BYTES and fail silently. Always verify size > 0 after any copy.
The `zip` binary fails on its rename step. Build archives in scratch with Python's zipfile, then copy in.
No connector, so deletion has no fallback path if Cowork's permission prompt is declined.
sharing: iCloud folder sharing is possible but awkward for multi-user work. Prefer Dropbox or Drive if sharing.
